When `AND` and `OR` are both used in the expression, parentheses must be appropriately used to group the combinations. Example: `location="us-east1"` Example: `container="projects/123" OR container="projects/456"` Example: `(container="projects/123" OR container="projects/456") AND location="us-east1"` Additional specific fields for query stats are: `metric_window`, `query_hash`, `normalized_query`.
